claims.statement: Item archive guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; pinned project variable resolves 50,000 items across active and archived. Moving items to archive does not reclaim this quota.
Archive retains project context while removing item from active views; automatic archive is separate optional workflow. Item absence from a view is not deletion, issue closure or completed work.

Selection includes table row/board card and multi-select with platform keys, ranges or select-all; row actions differ by table/roadmap versus board. Bulk selection can expand mutation scope and requires exact item identities, not ambiguous highlighted titles.
Archive flow requires Archive and confirmation; confirmation is not an approval for this estate or proof effective state after operation.

Restore navigates Archived items, optionally filters, selects individual/multiple items and clicks Restore. Filter display and button do not prove all intended items restored, field preservation or absence of immediate re-archiving by enabled automation.

Delete from project removes project item entirely, distinguished from deleting underlying repository issue/PR. Source does not specify recoverability of deleted draft content or project custom-field data; do not assume restoration through archive.

No permission matrix or automatic workflow suspension is specified. No items archived/restored/deleted or repository issue changed; all claims reference-only pending native behavior, rights and accepted policy evidence.
